0022600223.text: The Brooklyn Nets (2-8, 13th in the East) are on the road against the New Orleans Pelicans (4-7, 12th in the West), with Brooklyn on a two-game losing streak and 1-5 away from home. Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Mikel Brown Jr. (illness), and Nolan Traore is day-to-day with calf soreness and a game-time decision, while New Orleans is missing Bennedict Mathurin (thumb sprain), Trendon Watford (ankle sprain), and Yves Missi (knee bruise), with Trey Murphy III also day-to-day with knee tendinitis and a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the last meeting was a 116-113 Nets loss in New Orleans on January 14, 2026, and this is their first meeting of the 2026-27 season.
